Context: (xiv) Simplification of referral system»

All private hospitals empanelled under CGHS must ensure that CGHS beneficiaries referred by Government Specialists / CGHS Medical Officers are provided OPD consultation facilities by Specialists and they shall not charge more than the CGHS consultation charges. - OM, dated 21-2-2019.  
- In case of Haemo-Dialysis, the advice for treatment can be made up to six months and in such cases the advice shall be valid for
- (iv) up to six months.
